intelligence.enrichment: Vitamins and minerals are protective nutrients because they protect the body from diseases and keep it healthy; deficiency of Vitamin C causes scurvy, and Vitamin C in citrus fruits helps cure scurvy. lack of a needed vitamin or mineral -> deficiency disease or disorder; supplying the needed protective nutrient -> recovery or prevention support The learner correctly applies this rule: Vitamins and minerals are protective nutrients because they protect the body from diseases and keep it healthy; deficiency of Vitamin C causes scurvy, and Vitamin C in citrus fruits helps cure scurvy. Any fruit or salt cures any deficiency disease because all protective foods work the same way.
